verdict.rationale: LlamaParse publishes a keyless OpenAPI 3.1 spec and getting-started/examples pages with code snippets across multiple languages (Python, TS, Go, Java, CLI, REST), giving the raw material for an API reference, and probes confirm the spec and endpoints are live. However, there is no evidence of an actual interactive 'try-it-out' console, embedded runnable code sandbox, or Swagger/Redoc UI—docs show static code blocks rather than executable examples. Missing for 10: interactive try-it-out UI, in-browser runnable code execution, confirmation of a rendered API reference page (Swagger/Redoc) rather than just a spec file.
